reviews.text: Flew 32 hours to New Zealand to explore and enjoy its culture. Only to find myself eating at this establishment multiple times. How crazy does that sound, the asador was a magician. The tomohawk steak, the ribeye, the empanadas, the chorizo and the Argentina wine were superb. The craziest statement is that I will miss this place the most when I return home. Thank you for a wonderful taste of home!
Empanadas, roasted potatoes, french fries, chicken, pimpanada and beef and banana. Absolutely fantastic amazing highly recommend!

(Translated by Google) Cande welcomed us with incredible warmth and, for a little while, made us feel like we were back in Argentina. The barbecue area embraced us like a little piece of home, despite being thousands of kilometers away, and made being away from home much easier. (Original) Cande nos atendió con una calidez increíble y, por un ratito, nos hizo sentir de nuevo en Argentina. El quincho nos abrazó como un pedacito de casa, a pesar de estar a miles de kilómetros de distancia, y nos hizo mucho más liviano estar lejos de nuestro hogar.

Lovely food (I felt like back home for a bit) and great service from the two girls that serves us ( a girl from Argentina and a chilean gal). We liked the steak sandwich so much that we came back for dinner before we left Christchurch

We visted the city as part of our international cruise and we ate at El Quincho. The food is so good. Love the sauce or chimichurri over the flame grilled meat. The perfect place for delicious food and wine at a resanoble price. Thank you.
